title: I moved to the countryside at 23 years old - how I made it work for me
en: foreign and just like that Autumn is gone the snow came last week then turned into a blizzard that left everything buried under a thick blanket of snow we usually don't get this much so early in November and I have a feeling it's going to be a long winter even though I don't always deal with the

cold well I'm excited for what this season represents It's Time For Peace and renewal to go into the quiet with Grace and a humble heart the winter fairies are fearsome creatures but they have much to teach us I think this time of year challenges me to learn about my inner self as I cozy up in my home to wait for the new year thank you foreign I've made countless videos on we were

living why I chose it and why it works for me but I wanted to consider another side to my reasons to keep living out here and that story starts at five years old even though due to my father's job I was mostly schooled at home I did have the opportunity to go for a bit to an enrichment program on the weekends spending time with other students and teachers while I was there many of my superiors noticed I was having a hard time listening and following instructions my mind would wander and the noisy environment would constantly distract me with so many smells sights colors sounds surrounding me in my classroom I was overwhelmed foreign

I got tested for a variety of things but all that was found for certain was that I love to read and write and create and though I struggled a bit socially I was a happy child with a love of learning and to my mother that was What mattered I loved chaotic and busy places I wanted

to travel and explore but I needed a place to go to be myself in quietness I didn't have to live in a rural area to find that haven I could create a version of it most anywhere but once I got the opportunity to work as a preschool teacher in this little Valley I had a feeling I was going to be here long term and so far it is true I'm ever grateful and humbled by that opportunity thank you many people like my lovely sister much

prefer the city environment and couldn't imagine living anywhere else and to this day I love to visit her and experience the immense wonder that is a metropolis it's exciting and I can enjoy it while still looking forward to returning to my life in the countryside and I think this contrast is the reason living out here doesn't work for everyone it is quiet too quiet for many I know people often joke that that sounds great but the reality of it can be hard sometimes even for me however I knew from a young age that I'd enjoy living in a place where I could experience more of that slowness giving my body a nervous system of safe space I'm in an environment that aids me but I

can apply these things wherever I live that is why we were living works for me as a sensitive person I thrive in an environment where I can find that simple space and don't get me wrong I think you can create that space Wherever You Are I treated my former apartment in the city as my Haven after a long day I had a closet full of pillows where I would sit and listen to calming music if I felt drained I had a weighted blanket I'd lay on top of me if I couldn't sleep and it would help me relax I had boundaries in regards to socializing so that I could have time to rejuvenate and if you think any of this sounds strange or abnormal I've heard it before but I think it's more important to understand and honor who you are and

find ways to bring peace into your life if you need it and not worry so much about being labeled as odd or unusual I've been able to keep creating videos start my little Etsy shop and even work at a couple bookstores because I keep learning how to listen to what I need both my lifestyle and priorities and that has helped me be someone I'm proud of you don't need to live in the countryside if you're a sensitive person not at all but you do need to accept and embrace who you are I firmly believe that every well-adjusted individual has a hint of strangeness and Whimsy in their person or if not it's simply waiting to be discovered

thank you foreign it has been a lovely week over here and very quiet I've not yet gotten the snow tires changed on my car so I'm trying not to drive too much and it kind of feels like I'm snowed in so I've been

taking all this time to create some ornaments and other craft projects for my family I'm getting an early start on winter holiday gifts and I wanted to try to create some clay ornaments with dried flowers as well as some paper flowers I saw some tutorials online I really wanted to try I hope these give you some ideas if you're trying to make your own gifts this year and I appreciate you being here thank you so much my Etsy Shop will be closing in a couple weeks for the month of December I appreciate your support of my work and this channel I hope you have a beautiful week do you send the winter fairies well wishes they are working so hard over here to cover

every inch of this Valley with snow foreign I always knew that I would be suited to living in the countryside comes very naturally to my personality one of the reasons I started this channel was because I was aware that rural living really does not work for everyone and that's wonderful because that means we are all different and unique and that's it's really important I did however want to share a little bit of the nature and the beauty of wildlands hopefully Inspire other people to get involved in the preservation of these beautiful

areas I think it is so lovely to have a platform where artists can share their short films and their creative Endeavors I think for me I've always described these videos as my own way of immersing myself in a fairy tale and I love to find angles and interesting ways of portraying the beauty of Nature and home life these videos are often my way to celebrate the beauty and life and the Wonder and Whimsy of the world while still sharing the natural ups and downs that all humans deal with I'm so grateful that I have found other people that also appreciate that and that more artistic take on life I will be taking a little bit of a break from YouTube it's going to be short but I really had some more personal things I wanted to figure

out and a little bit more of an idea of what I want to do in the future I realized there were some things that I really need to figure out in regards to work and my schedule and some personal things as well so I'm going to be taking some time this week to think about that and how that may or may not impact this channel so I'm sending all of you my love thank you again sending you kisses from the snow fairies because they are working so hard goodbye foreign foreign
zh: 外国的，就像秋天过去了，上周下雪，然后变成了一场暴风雪，把所有的东西都埋在厚厚的雪下，我们通常不会在十一月这么早得到这么多，我有一种感觉，这将是一个漫长的冬天，尽管我并不总是处理
寒冷，我对这个季节所代表的东西感到兴奋 现在是和平和更新的时候了，带着优雅和谦虚的心进入安静，冬天的仙女是可怕的生物，但他们有很多东西可以教给我们
生活为什么我选择它以及为什么它对我有用，但我想考虑我继续住在这里的原因的另一面，这个故事从五岁开始，尽管由于我父亲的工作，我大部分时间都在家上学，我确实有机会在周末参加一些强化课程，与其他学生和老师一起度过，而我在那里的时候，许多上级注意到我很难听和遵循指示，我的思绪会走神，嘈杂的环境会不断地让我分心，有这么多的气味、景象、颜色、声音在教室里包围着我，我被异国情调淹没了
我接受了各种各样的测试，但可以肯定的是，我喜欢阅读、写作和创造，虽然我在社交方面有点挣扎，但我是一个快乐的孩子，热爱学习，对我的母亲来说，这才是重要的，我喜欢混乱和繁忙的地方，我想要
去旅行和探索，但我需要一个地方让自己安静地做自己，我不必住在农村地区才能找到避风港，我可以在任何地方创建一个它的版本，但一旦我有机会在这个小山谷里担任学前班老师，我就有一种感觉，我会在这里长期工作，到目前为止，这是真的，我对这个机会感到感激和谦卑，谢谢很多人，非常喜欢我可爱的妹妹
更喜欢城市环境，无法想象生活在其他地方，直到今天，我喜欢拜访她，体验大都市的巨大奇迹，这很令人兴奋，我可以享受它，同时仍然期待着回到乡村生活，我认为这种对比是住在这里并不适合每个人的原因，对很多人来说太安静了我知道人们经常开玩笑说这听起来很棒，但现实有时甚至对我来说也很难，但我从小就知道我喜欢住在一个我可以体验的地方更多的缓慢给我的身体一个安全空间的神经系统我处于一个对我有帮助的环境中，但我

无论我住在哪里，这就是为什么我们生活对我来说是一个敏感的人，我在一个可以找到简单空间的环境中茁壮成长，不要误会我的意思，我想你可以创造那个空间，无论你在哪里，我把我以前在城里的公寓当作我漫长一天后的避风港，我有一个装满枕头的衣柜，如果我感到精疲力竭，我会坐在里面听平静的音乐，我有一条加重的毯子，如果我睡不着，我会躺在我身上，它会帮助我放松。社交方面的界限，这样我就有时间恢复活力，如果你认为这听起来很奇怪或不正常，我以前听过，但我认为更重要的是理解和尊重你是谁，

find ways to bring peace into your life if you need it and not worry so much about being labeled as odd or unusual I've been able to keep creating videos start my little Etsy shop and even work at a couple bookstores because I keep learning how to listen to what I need both my lifestyle and priorities and that has helped me be someone I'm proud of you don't need to live in the countryside if you're a sensitive person not at all but you do need to accept and embrace who you are I firmly believe that every well-adjusted个人身上有一丝奇怪和奇思妙想，或者如果没有的话，只是等待被发现
谢谢你，外国人，在这里度过了愉快的一周，非常安静，我还没有更换我车上的雪地轮胎，所以我尽量不要开太多车，感觉就像被雪困住了，所以我一直在

花这么多时间为我的家人制作一些装饰品和其他工艺品项目我正在尽早开始制作冬季节日礼物，我想尝试用干花制作一些粘土装饰品以及一些纸花我在网上看到了一些教程我真的很想尝试如果你想今年制作自己的礼物，我希望这些能给你一些想法，我感谢你来到这里，非常感谢你，我的 Etsy 商店将在 12 月份的几周内关闭，感谢你对我的工作和这个频道的支持，我希望你祝你度过了美好的一周，你向冬天的仙女们致以良好的祝愿吗？他们在这里努力工作，以覆盖一切
这个山谷的每一寸地方都有雪，我一直都知道我会适合生活在乡村，这对我的个性来说是很自然的，我开始这个频道的原因之一是因为我意识到乡村生活并不适合每个人，这很棒，因为这意味着我们都是不同的和独特的，这非常重要，但我确实想分享一点自然和荒地的美丽，希望能激励其他人参与保护这些美丽的事情

我认为有一个平台让艺术家可以分享他们的短片和他们的创意努力真是太好了我想对我来说，我一直将这些视频描述为我自己沉浸在童话故事中的方式，我喜欢寻找角度和有趣的方式来描绘自然和家庭生活的美丽，这些视频通常是我庆祝世界的美丽和生活以及奇迹和奇思妙想的方式，同时仍然分享所有人类所面对的自然起伏我非常感激我找到了其他人们也欣赏这一点以及对生活更具艺术性的看法 我将从 YouTube 上休息一下，时间会很短，但我确实有一些更个人的事情想要弄清楚
我意识到，在工作、日程安排以及一些个人事情方面，我确实需要弄清楚一些事情，所以这周我将花一些时间来思考这个问题，以及这可能会或可能不会影响这个频道，所以我向你们所有人致以我的爱，谢谢你们，再次向你们发送来自雪仙子的吻，因为他们正在努力再见外国人
